summary: Present the complete native SLO inventory in diagnostics and fixed Mac signal tiles

replay.detail: Presentation only; no stored claim changes.

schema.detail: Uses existing SLO projections without client schema or generated-client changes.

rules.detail: Native objective evaluations remain authoritative; consumers do not evaluate thresholds.

compatibility.detail: Doctor lists all native objective and budget rows, including declared objectives, rather than independently judging request telemetry. Every SLO row is informational: the native status, tone, current reading, target and window appear in the text, but verdicts describe and never gate `fractal doctor --strict`, and no SLO row is ever presented as a successful check. The superseded telemetry-only diagnostic evaluator is removed. The Mac signal board retains ten tiles and includes the native objective families in its drill-down membership.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary and app rollback; no persisted-state changes.
